name: Electromagnetism in a nutshell
description: An introduction to the fundamental principles and mathematical framework of electromagnetism, including vector calculus and electrostatics.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 — Vector Calculus
chapters.description: This lecture introduces the mathematical framework of vector calculus, including vector fields, divergence, curl, and the fundamental theorems of vector calculus.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — Electrostatics
chapters.description: in this lecture, we explore the principles of electrostatics, including Coulomb's law, electric fields, Gauss's law

image.alt: Abstract purple, pink, and blue light trails illustrating electromagnetism

name: Quantum Mechanics
description: An introduction to the fundamental principles and applications of quantum mechanics.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 — Introduction to Quantum Mechanics
chapters.description: This lecture introduces the historical development of quantum mechanics, the Schrödinger equation, Born’s probability interpretation, wavefunction normalization, expectation values, statistical uncertainty, and the operators associated with position and momentum.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — The Schrödinger Equation
chapters.description: Probability interpretation, normalization, and time evolution.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 — Formalism of Quantum Mechanics
chapters.description: A discussion of the mathematical formalism of quantum theory, consisting of states in Hilbert space and operators corresponding to observables.

image.alt: Colorful cat silhouette surrounded by quantum equations and geometric diagrams

name: Linear Algebra for Quantum Mechanics
description: A concise introduction to linear algebra, focusing on the concepts and techniques most relevant to quantum mechanics.

image.alt: Intersecting planes and vectors in three-dimensional space

name: QED and Pseudo Quantum Electrodynamics
description: discussion of a recent extension of QED applicable to condensed matter systems, known as Pseudo Quantum Electrodynamics (PQED).

name: Topology of R
description: A discussion of the topology of the real line, including open and closed sets, limit points, and continuity.

name: Alexandroff Spaces
description: An introduction to Alexandroff spaces, a class of topological spaces that are particularly useful in the study of order theory and lattice theory.

chapters.title: introduction to Alexandroff Spaces
chapters.description: This paper introduces the concept of Alexandroff spaces, their properties, and examples

chapters.title: Presentation - Alexandroff Spaces
chapters.description: This presentation provides an overview of Alexandroff spaces, including their definitionn

name: Partition Theory
description: An introduction to partition theory, a branch of number theory that deals with the ways of writing a number as a sum of positive integers.

chapters.title: introduction to Partition Theory
chapters.description: This paper introduces the concept of partition theory, their properties, and examples

chapters.title: Presentation - Partition Theory
chapters.description: This presentation provides an overview of partition theory, including their definitionn

name: Calculus of Variations
description: A discussion of the calculus of variations, including the Euler-Lagrange equation and its applications.
